# Ideomint

> Ideomint is a premier creative experience company specializing in brand strategy, web application design, digital experiences, and event management.

## About Ideomint
Different Sections. One Creative Vision. We partner with brands to craft memorable digital products, bespoke websites, and immersive live event experiences.

## Core Services
- **Brand Strategy & Identity**: Visual identity, design systems, and positioning.
- **Web Design & Development**: Modern high-performance web applications built with Next.js & React.
- **Ideofest Ticket & Event Management**: End-to-end ticketing, QR pass generation, and venue entrance verification.
